name: io.github.cyberkurry/pkv-sync
description: Self-hosted, Git-native Obsidian vault sync with a built-in MCP server, search, and wiki lint.
title: PKV Sync

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the PKV Sync data directory (SQLite metadata plus the bare git vaults)

data_dir.description: Host directory that holds the PKV Sync data

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the server config file read-only

config_file.description: Host path of the config.toml the server already runs with

environmentVariables.name: PKV_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A PKV Sync device token with access to the vault this session should expose

environmentVariables.name: PKV_VAULT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Vault id the MCP session exposes (the vault is listed in the admin panel)
